format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
ggplot(data = penguins, 
       aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = species), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, size = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "#FF8C00", "Chinstrap" = "#9932CC", "Gentoo" = "#008B8B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill Dimensions by Species",
    subtitle = "Relationship between bill length and bill depth for Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo Penguins",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Bill Depth (mm)",
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Species",
    caption = "Source: Palmer Station LTER | palmerpenguins package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#2F4F4F", margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#696969", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#888888", face = "italic", margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2F4F4F"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#4F4F4F"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ECECEC", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#2F4F4F"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#4F4F4F"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA)
  )
```
